fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/TabbedModelOffers.cy.js#UtilityPages - TabbedModelOffers [offers] [en] — Offers TC-TMO-03: Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Offers
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TMO-03
**Title:** Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Offers
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Offers page, open Check Offers on the default tab, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Offers page
2. Click a model card's "Check Offers" button
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
